items.title: GitHub Actions Is Changing pull_request_target — Check Your Workflows Before December 2
items.excerpt:
Developer roundup · November 1–8, 2026

A contributor opens a pull request from a fork. Your workflow checks out their code and runs a test script. If that workflow uses pull_request_target, the script can run with access to the base repository’s secrets. That’s the risk behind a GitHub Actions default that changes on December 2.
